bot

The goal of bot (Bundle Optimal Transport) is to implement statistical methods for diffusion MRI tractography data, centered on optimal transport between fiber bundles.

bot is one member of the tractoverse family of packages.

Installation

You can install the development version of bot from GitHub with:

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("tractoverse/bot")

Status

bot is under active development (v0.0.0.9000) and does not yet expose a stable API. The bundle optimal transport methods it will implement are still being designed. Meanwhile, the slot for this role in the tractoverse family is reserved by a placeholder export.
